race.title: Midnite Churchill Stakes (Listed)
race.verdict: MILITARY ORDER is rock solid on this surface and at this level, so should prove hard to beat if over his exertions in the desert. Warrant Holder rates a big threat back down in class, with Spinning Wheel best of the others. MILITARY ORDER (IRE) WARRANT HOLDER (IRE) SPINNING WHEEL
race.bettingForecast: Military Order (10/11), Warrant Holder (5/2), By The Book (8/1), Spinning Wheel (10/1), Old Harrovian (14/1), Zgharta (16/1), The Resdev Tyke (100/1)
